name: SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform
description:
SaaSify is a cloud GTM  platform that lets software vendors sell and manage their products across AWS Marketplace, the Microsoft commercial marketplace (AMP), and Google Cloud Marketplace from one place. This connector brings your live SaaSify account into Claude so you can ask about your marketplace business in plain language  and gather insights.

Ask about earned vs. settled revenue by cloud and by month, active subscriptions and growth, private-offer deals and their total contract value (TCV), offers, plans and current price books, customers, marketplace leads, and cloud co-sell pipeline. Build revenue-ops worklists too: subscriptions awaiting activation, customers with expiring renewals, and seller accounts whose credentials are nearing expiry. Drill into any subscription or deal for status, payment terms, metered usage and cost, publish errors, and a full audit trail.

You sign in with your existing SaaSify login (email/password, Microsoft, Google, or Okta) over OAuth. Access is per-user and scoped to exactly the tenants and roles your account is entitled to; if you belong to several seller accounts you choose which one to query. The connector is read-only — it reports your numbers and never creates, changes, or deletes anything. Answers come from your live SaaSify data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.saasify.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform lists 29 MCP tools, including get_awaiting_activation, get_deal_details, get_earned_revenue_report, get_entity_audit_log, get_expiring_customers, get_invoice_revenue_by_month, get_marketplace_revenue_summary, get_my_profile, get_plan_pricing, get_revenue_by_cloud, get_subscription_details, and get_subscription_usage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: SaaSify - Cloud Marketplaces GTM Platform is developed by SaaSify by Spektra Systems. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
